name: File / storage
author: hundekraft
description: Hold Shift and press COM. The COM screen opens. On the OP-1 tab (T1), hold Shift and press COM again. FILE opens. The same keys switch back. In CTRL, DISK or OPT, Shift + COM does what it always did; press T1 first to reach FILE.
credits: Rebuilt by hundekraft from how Maiko Pruett's #249 and #250 work; none of Maiko's code is used
